// diagnostic

E2111

A collector-owned graph cannot leave its scoped GC policy here.

What

A collector-owned graph cannot leave its scoped GC policy here.

Why

The callee returns hidden traced storage, but the receiving function is governed by ordinary ownership.

Fix

add `#Policy(gc)` to the receiving function or convert the graph to ordinary ownership before the boundary.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2111: tests/ui/gc_escape_ownership.stderr.

Error [E2111]: `values` cannot leave its scoped GC policy here
  --> tests/ui/gc_escape_ownership.jet:10:5
    |
 10 |     values :: promoted()
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: the called function returns a collector-owned graph, but this function is ownership-only
 Fix: add `#Policy(gc)` to this function or convert the returned graph to ordinary ownership before the boundary
